name: Vellora Executive Desk

Precision-crafted with a Galvanized Iron (GI) architectural outer frame and reinforced Mild Steel (MS) structural core, it is finished in a pure white electrostatic powder coating. The integrated storage-inspired front panel, smooth curved edges, and refined proportions create a seamless balance between function, elegance, and contemporary design.

name: Aeris Rocking Chair
shortDescription: A sculptural wireframe rocking chair crafted with Galvanized Iron & Mild Steel, featuring steam-bent natural wood runners and a plush tufted cushion.
description: The Aeris Rocking Chair is a sculptural modern accent piece combining an airy Galvanized Iron (GI) wireframe bucket silhouette with heavy-gauge Mild Steel (MS) structural cross-bracing and steam-bent solid wood runners. Finished in an architectural matte black electrostatic powder coating, Aeris is complemented by a plush, high-resilience tufted cloud cushion. The contoured wireform design provides ergonomic lumbar cradling while showcasing an open, floating aesthetic that elevates luxury living spaces, private reading nooks, executive lounges, and covered verandas.
